Name: (CP) Hair Hue
Author: celeryicemelon
Description:
[color=#d9ead3][size=4][b]How to install this mod:[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*]Have SMAPI and Content Patcher installed
[*]Download the mod
[*]Backup your game files (optional)
[*]Load Stardew with the mod installed to load the config file
[*]Enter the swatch you have chosen minus the spaces into the quotation marks in the config file
[*]Load up your game and enjoy!
[/list]
[color=#d9ead3][size=4][b]DISCLAIMER:[/b][/size][/color]
The hair colour you choose when you create your character goes below the shading. So, the colour of the shading will look different depending on what your hair colour is.
